name: Schrat
source:
One of an elusive group of mythical beings known as the Waldleute. Although feminine in appearence, they have no fixed gender.
It is said that all Waldleute can offer blessings to those who bring them gifts, but every blessing a Waldleute bestows on a human will ultimately cost more than most would be willing to pay.

[From [url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/dawnofthedamned]Itch.io[/url]]
